plate_comment: The boot kernel's copy (ROM 0x3C30-0x7F60 image) of cm848_writeCanControllerTxMailbox, byte for byte: copies the ID and 8 data bytes (6 halfwords) into TouCAN A message buffer (number - 1) and writes 0xC8 (transmit once, length 8) to its control byte. Called by mpc555_canTransmitQueuePush and mpc555_manageCan1TransmitBuffer. The old 'Can2' was not a second controller (was cm848_writeCan2ControllerTxMailbox)
